1.t: (The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم) frowned and turned away.

2.t: Because there came to him the blind man (i.e. ‘Abdullâh bin Umm-Maktûm, who came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم while he was preaching to one or some of the Quraish chiefs).

3.t: And how can you know that he might become pure (from sins)?

4.t: Or he might receive admonition, and the admonition might profit him?

5.t: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,

7.t: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure (from disbelief: you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allâh).

8.t: But as to him who came to you running,

9.t: And is afraid (of Allâh and His punishment).

10.t: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,

11.t: Nay, (do not do like this); indeed it (this Qur’ân) is an admonition.

12.t: So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it.

13.t: (It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz),

17.t: Be cursed (the disbelieving) man! How ungrateful he is!

18.t: From what thing did He create him?

19.t: From Nutfah (male and female semen drops) He created him and then set him in due proportion.

20.t: Then He makes the Path easy for him.

21.t: Then He causes him to die and puts him in his grave.

22.t: Then when it is His Will, He will resurrect him (again).

23.t: Nay, but (man) has not done what He commanded him.

24.t: Then let man look at his food:

25.t: We pour forth water in abundance.

26.t: And We split the earth in clefts.

27.t: And We cause therein the grain to grow,

28.t: And grapes and clover plants (i.e. green fodder for the cattle),

30.t: And gardens dense with many trees,

32.t: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

33.t: Then when there comes As-Sâkhkhah (the second blowing of the Trumpet on the Day of Resurrection)

34.t: That Day shall a man flee from his brother,

35.t: And from his mother and his father,

36.t: And from his wife and his children.

37.t: Everyman that Day will have enough to make him careless of others.

38.t: Some faces that Day will be bright (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism),

39.t: Laughing, rejoicing at good news (of Paradise).

40.t: And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained.

42.t: Such will be the Kafarah (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, etc.), the Fajarah (wicked evil doers).
